section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the Social Safeness and Pleasure Scale (SSPS), a 11-item instrument measuring perceptions of social safeness and acceptance using a 5-point Likert scale. The original scale demonstrated internal consistency of α=0.92, while the current study achieved α=0.96. No study-level demographic or methodological information is provided in this section.
